name: wallpaper-hub
description: Wallpaper Hub - polyglot microservice reference (TypeScript / NestJS implementation)

scripts.apps:up: pnpm tls:dev-certs && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile apps up -d --build
scripts.apps:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile apps down
scripts.apps:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile apps logs -f account-service
scripts.apps:stop: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile apps stop account-service
scripts.apps:ps: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile infra --profile apps ps -a
scripts.ci:account: pnpm --filter account-service check && pnpm --filter account-service openapi:check
